# HSE - Health Service Executive

> Ireland's primary health service provider offering comprehensive healthcare information, service directories, medical schemes, and health conditions reference.

The HSE (Health Service Executive) is Ireland's national health service organization. This website serves as the central portal for Irish citizens to access healthcare services, find medical facilities, apply for healthcare schemes, and obtain evidence-based health information across pregnancy, mental health, emergency care, and chronic conditions.

## Key Topics

- Medical Cards
- GP Visit Cards
- European Health Insurance Card (EHIC)
- Drugs Payment Scheme
- Emergency Care
- GP Locator
- Vaccine Services
- Mental Health Support
- Pregnancy and Birth
- Health A-Z Reference
- TrolleyGAR (Hospital Capacity)
- Civil Registration
- Out-of-Hours Care
- Healthcare Eligibility
- Irish Healthcare System

## Core Services & Directories

- [HSE website - Health Service Executive](https://www2.hse.ie): HSE homepage providing health services directory, A-Z conditions database, and online services
- [HSE services](https://www2.hse.ie/services): Directory of HSE health services, schemes, and allowances across Ireland
- [Find a GP in Ireland - HSE.ie](https://www2.hse.ie/services/find-a-gp): GP practice locator with contact details and opening hours
- [Find urgent and emergency care in Ireland - HSE.ie](https://www2.hse.ie/services/find-urgent-emergency-care): Emergency departments, injury units, and GP out-of-hours service locator
- [Find a vaccine location in Ireland - HSE.ie](https://www2.hse.ie/services/find-a-vaccine): Vaccine location finder for flu and COVID-19 vaccination services
- [Find a civil registration service in Ireland - HSE.ie](https://www2.hse.ie/services/births-deaths-and-marriages/find-a-civil-registration-service): Civil registration service locator for births, deaths, and marriages

## Healthcare Schemes & Allowances

- [Schemes and allowances](https://www2.hse.ie/services/schemes-allowances): Overview of HSE healthcare schemes and financial assistance programs
- [Medical cards](https://www2.hse.ie/services/schemes-allowances/medical-cards): Guide to HSE medical cards for free healthcare access in Ireland
- [GP visit cards](https://www2.hse.ie/services/schemes-allowances/gp-visit-cards): GP visit card types and application information for free GP visits
- [GP visit cards](https://www2.hse.ie/services/schemes-allowances/gp-visit-cards/gp-visit-cards): GP visit card schemes for free GP visits in Ireland
- [Drugs Payment Scheme](https://www2.hse.ie/services/schemes-allowances/drugs-payment-scheme): Drugs Payment Scheme guide for prescription medication cost savings
- [European Health Insurance Card (EHIC)](https://www2.hse.ie/services/schemes-allowances/ehic): EHIC application and renewal guide for healthcare in EU/EEA states

## Emergency Care & Hospital Services

- [Urgent and emergency care](https://www2.hse.ie/services/urgent-emergency-care): Emergency departments and injury units overview with contact information
- [Urgent and emergency care report (daily)](https://www2.hse.ie/services/urgent-emergency-care-report): Daily TrolleyGAR hospital emergency department capacity report

## Health Information & Reference

- [Health A to Z](https://www2.hse.ie/conditions): Comprehensive A-Z medical conditions and treatments reference database
- [Flu (influenza)](https://www2.hse.ie/conditions/flu): Flu overview, symptoms, diagnosis, and vaccination information

## Life Stage Health Guides

- [Pregnancy and birth](https://www2.hse.ie/pregnancy-birth): Pregnancy, labour and birth guides with expert health information
- [Babies and children](https://www2.hse.ie/babies-children): Baby and child care guides covering feeding, development, and health
- [Mental health](https://www2.hse.ie/mental-health): Mental health information, support resources, and coping strategies
- [Living well](https://www2.hse.ie/living-well): Health and wellness advice for mental and physical health maintenance
